children.text: The applicant must be a resident of the respective state.
The applicant must be a girl student.
She must have secured a first division in her matriculation examination.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: - The applicant must be a resident of the respective state. - The applicant must be a girl student. - She must have secured a first division in her matriculation examination.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme provides a financial incentive to girls who achieve a first division in their matriculation examination.

children.text: "Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana", launched by the Education Department, Bihar, aims to promote education among girls and encourage academic excellence. The scheme rewards girls who secure a first division in their matriculation examination with a one-time financial incentive of ₹10,000/-.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: &quot;Mukhyamantri Balika Protsahan Yojana&quot;, launched by the Education Department, Bihar, aims to promote education among girls and encourage academic excellence. The scheme rewards girls who secure a first division in their matriculation examination with a one-time financial incentive of ₹10,000/-.
